messages:
Anya: Quick Q — can someone confirm who is allowed to flip the emergency toggle for the routing plane? Need to stop the new model rollout for cust-A ASAP and want the right audit trail.
Devon: @Anya you, @Leo, and @Sylvia are in the emergency keyholders group per last week's update. Ops needs an approval chain recorded before we flip for prod.
Anya: Got it. I don't want to do a hard kill if we can do a scoped disable (canary only). Who can scope it to region=us-west and audience=canary?
Leo: I can run a scoped disable. Preferred flow: 1) Create a short justification, 2) get 1 other approver, 3) call the toggle with audit metadata.
Sylvia: +1 — also add the incident ID in the audit metadata so we can trace across observability.
Anya: OK will do. Drafting justification: "Observed memory spikes with model-v3 during canary in us-west — pausing rollout to prevent customer impact." Anyone object?
Matt: No objections. FYI add the commit sha and runbook link.
Anya: Copy. Approver: @Devon — can you ACK?
Devon: ACK. Approving for scoped disable.
Anya: Executing the scoped toggle now. Command I will run: ```bash
# scoped disable for cust-A canary in us-west
rctl feature toggle --name rollout_cust_A --state off --scope region=us-west,audience=canary --audit "actor=Anya;approver=Devon;incident=INC-2026-108;commit=3f2a1b"
```
ops-bot: Audit entry created: id=aud_0x9f3a, actor=Anya, approver=Devon, action=toggle_off, target=rollout_cust_A, scope=region=us-west|audience=canary, time=2420001142
Anya: Toggle returned 200. Can you confirm traffic now bypasses canary pool?
Leo: Checking metrics -> looks like canary traffic dropped to 0 within 30s. Good.
Sylvia: Observability note: set alert to monitor error rate for 15m and open a follow-up to triage root cause.
Matt: I'll open a postmortem ticket and attach timeline + logs.
Anya: Thanks all. For records: who should sign off to re-enable? My proposal: require two approvers including one SRE and one PM. Thoughts?
Devon: SGTM. Add the condition that the monitoring window shows stable p99 latency and error rate for 30m.
Leo: Agreed. Also require canary run with small percentage (5%) for 15m before full rollout.
Sylvia: I'll add the re-enable checklist to the runbook and put the quick command snippet.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-108 created and linked to audit aud_0x9f3a. Assigned to: Matt.
Anya: All right — I'll update the ticket with the justification and mark the toggle action in the incident timeline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Matt: Ping me in the PR for the postmortem, will review tonight.
Anya: Done. Closing thread, will reopen if anything regresses.
